COP3530.title: Data Structures
COP3530.prerequisites: A second programming course plus, at most universities, discrete mathematics - published gates differ: UF (COP3503 or COP3504) + COT3100 + Calculus II, all C or better; FIU COP3337 + (MAD2104 or COT3100); FGCU COP3003 + MAD3107, C or better; UWF COP3014; Daytona State (COP2800, COP2220 or COP2360) + (COT3100 or MAD2104); Eastern Florida COP2334 or COP2800, C or better; Palm Beach State COP1000 + one language course; Miami Dade COP2800 (Java). *** The B.A.S. versions at the colleges require no mathematics; take discrete math before transferring into a CS degree. *** Check the LANGUAGE (Java or C++) before enrolling. *** Not the same as COP3538 Data Structures for IT, which the state says is not acceptable for CS majors. *** The statewide prerequisite (CIS 3020) names a course no Florida institution carries.

offering_notes.summary: Eleven public carriers. Ten carry it at 3 credits; Miami Dade College carries it at 4. Florida Atlantic teaches the same course as COP3530C. No institution publishes contact hours.
offering_notes.derivation: Florida's convention of 15 contact hours per credit for a lecture course; the statewide record marks COP3530 as having no laboratory component. Miami Dade's 4-credit version works out at about 60.

offerings.title: Data Structures
